Newest first. Press the unplug icon to remove a device.
To share sound with the picture, grant the recording permission once from a computer: adb shell pm grant tv.webremote android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO

1. Turn on the Accessibility service and the Control server in the Status card.

2. Press “Pair a new device”. On your phone or computer, open the address shown in the Status card and enter the 6-digit PIN.

3. To watch the TV screen in the browser, turn on Screen sharing. Screen sharing also shares the TV sound: press the speaker icon on the web page to listen.

4. Paired devices are in the card below. Press the unplug icon to remove a device.

5. To use it away from home, install Tailscale and open the TV's 100.x.x.x address.
